text: {"name":"parse_adv_report","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Copies and decodes fields from a raw advertising receive record into the output report, including header-derived flags and scaled measurement values.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v4":"header_word","v5":"existing_flags","v7":"header_shift","v8":"decoded_flags","v9":"input_word_at_2","v12":"input_byte_at_10","v14":"raw_measurement","v17":"shifted_measurement","v19":"scaled_byte_value"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Decoded 16-bit header and status flags"},{"offset":2,"meaning":"Header field extracted from bits 7–9"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Boolean decoded from header bit 6"},{"offset":5,"meaning":"Header field extracted from bits 10–14; also used as a shift amount"},{"offset":7,"meaning":"Byte copied from input offset 10"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"16-bit value copied from input bytes 11–12"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"Input byte scaled by a shift selected from decoded flag bit 2"},{"offset":16,"meaning":"Raw measurement shifted by the header-derived amount"},{"offset":24,"meaning":"32-bit value copied from input offset 2"},{"offset":28,"meaning":"32-bit value copied from input offset 6"},{"offset":41,"meaning":"Byte copied from input offset 13"},{"offset":48,"meaning":"Fixed-point scaled value derived from the shifted measurement"}]}
